run_grounded_video_description_training: run the main training loop for grounded video description generation on ActivityNet dataset with configurable attention models
run_inference_only_mode: run inference-only mode to generate dense captions for video segments without training the model
eval_grounding_accuracy: evaluate object grounding and attention accuracy on ground truth sentences using the ANetGrdEval evaluator
visualize_attention_inference: visualize attention weights and generated bounding boxes over video frames using the vis_infer function
parse_training_options: parse command-line arguments for model configuration including dataset paths, optimizer settings, and evaluation flags via opts.parse_opt
